---
title: "Fig. 1D - WT germarium and late-stage ring canal composition"
output: null
---

Graphing of ring canal compositions in germaria and late-stage follicles.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
data_file <- "../Data/Fig1D_WT_germarium_late_stage_RC_composition.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Fig1D_WT_germarium_late_stage_RC_composition.pdf"

germarium_late_stage <- read_analysis_csv(data_file)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1D: calculate the percentage of each ring canal class in each sample.
# Collapse Pnut+ Pav/Vsg rings with Pav/Vsg rings so the comparison focuses on
# Pav and Vsg ring canal composition across stages.

germarium_late_stage_summary <- germarium_late_stage %>%
  filter(!Category %in% c("pnut", "pav_pnut")) %>%
  mutate(RCs = recode(Category, "pav_vsg_pnut" = "pav_vsg")) %>%
  group_by(FileName, Stage, RCs) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  group_by(FileName, Stage) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Count),
    Percent = 100 * Count / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1D: plot ring canal class percentages in germaria and late follicles.

ggplot(germarium_late_stage_summary, aes(x = RCs, y = Percent, fill = Stage)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = Stage), fill = "white", linewidth = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75),
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "Composition of ring canals at\nearly and late stages"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Pav+,Vsg-", "Pav+,Vsg+", "Pav-,Vsg+")) +
  manuscript_theme(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.3, 0.95),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85), color = NA),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.01, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 2)
  )
```

```{r}
ggsave(output_file, width = 2.75, height = 2, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1D: summary values for the plotted percentages.

summarize_mean_sd(
  germarium_late_stage_summary,
  group_cols = c("Stage", "RCs"),
  value_col = Percent
)
```
